title: Separate the acquired table, diagnostic and physical resource plan
statement: Source reports exact rational acquisition/circuit construction through16384 scalar spins plus rank2/3 inputs. The dynamical run instead uses eight physical qubits/two logical qubits and25 finite noisy pulses: reference-output trace error .0274588 versus proved full-diamond upper bound .0685132, final deep-code leakage .00639434. The trace error is not an optimized diamond norm. The separate bare-input/bare-output plan for288 logical qubits,1e6 idle units and five X gadgets has modeled total error<.005 including calibration failure, but ~1.08e11 control strength,2016 pure auxiliaries and~1.59e22 bounded-observation calibration trials. Source and calibration operations were NOTexecuted; these are chosen sufficient procedures,not necessary lower bounds or practical advantage. Encoded output can feed further qualified gates; bare output needs inverse-circuit/time allowance. Independent dephasing becomes b gamma logical dephasing on a b-leaf block and still needs active correction/real entropy outlets for long operation.

requires: Actual Hermitian commuting collective fields L_a=sum_i w_ai Z_i, fixed rank r, acquired coefficient intervals and specified generator D[L_a]; this is not arbitrary local noise.
Fixed depth k complementary-pair hierarchy and actual encoders/receivers; suitable trajectory-containing invariant subspaces are required for the control theorem.
All pulse duration/precision, external faults, calibration, source, measurement, decoding and terminal noise costs remain charged.
